name: Rusty Hardin
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Houston, Texas
education: Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law
about: Rusty Hardin attended law school and graduated from Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law in 1975. Rusty Hardin began practicing law in 1975.

Rusty Hardin is an attorney at Rusty Hardin & Associates, LLP, helping people with Business Litigation issues. Rusty Hardin & Associates, LLP has an office in Houston, Texas, serving the local community.

Rusty Hardin was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
